MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
OF
NORTHWIND HOLDINGS, INC.
February 22, 2025 at 2:00 p.m. Eastern (via Zoom)

DIRECTORS PRESENT: Angela K. Beaumont (Chair), Rafael J. Kim, Priya Naidu, Simon C. Aldridge, Dr. Helena Vorstman (constituting all five directors)
ALSO PRESENT: Marcus D. Trelawney (Secretary); Sarah L. Ito, Wilson, Frey & Ambrose LLP (outside counsel)

CALL TO ORDER
The Chair called the meeting to order at 2:03 p.m. Eastern and confirmed that notice of the meeting had been duly given and that a quorum was present.

APPROVAL OF PRIOR MINUTES
Upon motion duly made and seconded, the minutes of the January 15, 2025 regular meeting were unanimously approved.

FY2025 BUDGET REVIEW
The CFO presented the FY2025 Operating Budget. After discussion, the Board reviewed the budget assumptions, the sensitivity to the closing of the Series B Financing, and the proposed hiring plan. The independent directors asked management to circulate the underlying build-out spreadsheets by close of business February 24, 2025.

SERIES B PREFERRED STOCK FINANCING
Ms. Ito reviewed the material terms of the Series B Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement, the Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation, and the amended Investor Rights Agreement. The Chair confirmed that the term sheet had been circulated to all directors on February 5, 2025 and that legal counsel had been available to answer questions since that date. The Board discussed valuation, dilution, the redemption provisions, and the protective provisions in favor of the Series B. After discussion, on motion duly made by Ms. Naidu and seconded by Mr. Aldridge, the Board unanimously adopted the resolutions approving the Series B Financing set forth in the Unanimous Written Consent circulated separately.

RELATED-PARTY LEASE — K&B PROPERTIES LLC
The Chair disclosed that she and Mr. Kim are the beneficial owners of K&B Properties LLC and both recused themselves from this agenda item. Ms. Naidu chaired the balance of this item. Ms. Ito reviewed DGCL § 144 and confirmed the disinterested directors had been provided (i) the proposed lease, (ii) the Cushman-Ryland market survey dated January 30, 2025, and (iii) alternative available comparable space quotes obtained by the CFO. Dr. Vorstman asked whether the Corporation had solicited three arms-length alternatives; the CFO confirmed that three comparable spaces were quoted, with a range of $27.75 to $31.00 per square foot. The disinterested directors discussed and, on motion duly made by Dr. Vorstman and seconded by Mr. Aldridge, unanimously approved the lease as fair to the Corporation. Ms. Beaumont and Mr. Kim rejoined the meeting.

INDEPENDENT AUDITOR
On motion duly made and seconded, the Board unanimously approved the appointment of Fenwick Chen LLP as independent auditor for FY2025.

CYBERSECURITY OVERSIGHT
The CFO provided an update on the Corporation's information-security program, including the results of the quarterly penetration test. The Board directed management to add a standing cybersecurity report to each regular quarterly meeting agenda beginning Q2 2025.

ADJOURNMENT
There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 4:12 p.m. Eastern.

Respectfully submitted,
/s/ Marcus D. Trelawney, Secretary

APPROVED at the regular meeting of the Board held April 30, 2025:
/s/ Angela K. Beaumont, Chair
